# Notices for the Lanes

*Rufus's notices are not reaching the farms along the Cider Lanes, because folk have stopped walking in to hear them. Carry them out to the farm gate above the lanes and clear 30 orchard pigs.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Kaldemor](../towns/kaldemor_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Rufus](../npcs/rufus.md) |

## Objectives

- Defeat 30 [Orchard Pig](../monsters/orchard_pig.md)
- Reach the farm gate above the lanes in [The Cider Lanes](../maps/cider_lanes.md)

- 700 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
